name: cc-grammar
description: English while you write a prompt, for your eyes only. After a pause, the English of your draft shows in gray after it: translated from any language, or your English corrected. The key you bind to /english (Tab) takes it, and gives your words back. A message sent without seeing its English gets one gray ✎ line: the English, or up to 3 corrections ordered A1 → C1+. Your own words go to Haiku for this, drafts too; the conversation's model never sees any of it.

when.title: When
when.description: 'as I type': after a pause your draft goes to Haiku and its English shows in gray after it. 'after I send': a message whose English you did not see gets one gray ✎ line. 'off': nothing goes to Haiku unless you press the key.
options: as I type and after I send
when.default: as I type and after I send

rule_names.title: Rule names
rule_names.description: The language of the one-word rule name after each correction on the ✎ line (English, Ukrainian, Spanish, ...), or none.

pause.title: Pause (ms)
pause.description: How long after your last key the draft goes to Haiku.

longest.title: Longest draft (characters)
longest.description: The longest draft that gets gray English while you type, and the longest message in another language that gets a ✎ line. The key takes longer drafts too.
